svg.title: The hash ring
svg.desc: Consistent hashing ring diagram showing four servers positioned around a circular hash space from zero to two to the power thirty-two, with five keys placed on the ring, each key assigned to the first server found moving clockwise. A newly added server takes over only the keys in the arc before it.
